column2: Game sprite for a turn-based strategy board game map, seen from above at a three-quarter angle like a piece of a miniature diorama, soft painterly cel shading, thin dark outlines, natural colours, sunlight coming from the upper left so the left slopes are lit and the right slopes are in shadow, readable when shrunk to a small icon, centred, filling about 85 percent of the frame width, the bottom edge of the subject is a ragged natural footprint, no flat ground plane, no grass around it, no cast shadow, no text, no letters. The background is a perfectly flat solid pure magenta colour #FF00FF everywhere around the subject, with no gradient and no texture. Subject: a broad grey rocky mountain massif with three peaks of different heights, snow caps on the two highest peaks, steep ridges and gullies.
